earnings.title: Brown & Brown, Inc. announces third quarter 2026 results,
highlights: Total revenues of $1.7 billion, increasing $119 million, or 7.4%, compared to the third quarter of the prior year, with growth of Organic Revenue of 1.2% and growth of Organic Revenue with Contingents of 1.5%.
Net income attributable to the Company of $240 million, increasing $13 million, or 5.7%, compared to the third quarter of the prior year.
Diluted net income per share of $0.67, a decrease of 1.5%, with Diluted Net Income Per Share - Adjusted increasing to $1.07, or 1.9%, each compared to the third quarter of the prior year.
Total revenues of $5.3 billion, increasing $1.0 billion, or 23.4%, compared to the same period in 2025, with growth of Organic Revenue of 0.3% and growth of Organic Revenue with Contingents of 1.5%.
Net income attributable to the Company of $954 million, increasing $164 million, or 20.8%, compared to the same period in 2025.
